display.purpose: The wordmark only, in Kanit, set in Magenta Tube.

heading.purpose: The add/edit form title and the calendar month/year label, in Kanit.

body.purpose: Task titles, form fields, buttons, empty-state copy, in Mitr.

label.purpose: Chips, meta text, section headers, calendar-cell contents, priority badges, in Mitr.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Every panel (list item, task card, kanban column, form, day-detail panel) — a small neutral lift off the night ground. Never colored.

shadows.name: shadow-btn
shadows.purpose: Buttons at rest; cleared entirely on :active. Never colored — see The No-Glow Rule.

motion.name: press
motion.value: transform .08s ease, box-shadow .08s ease, filter .08s ease, border-color .08s ease
motion.purpose: Button press: scale(.97) + shadow cleared + brightness dip on :active.

motion.name: tint
motion.purpose: Hover tint and border-brighten shift on cards, calendar cells, and buttons.

motion.name: powerOff
motion.purpose: The one signature motion: a task's sign flickers and powers off when marked done or deleted. Never used for any other transition.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action button on a screen: sign in, add task, save.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">+ เพิ่มงาน</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-family: Mitr, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border, #2a2f45); background: var(--surface, #141726); color: var(--ink, #eef1fb); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 13px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.35); transition: transform .08s ease, box-shadow .08s ease, filter .08s ease; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(.97); box-shadow: none; filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, #ffcc33); color: var(--on-primary, #0b0d16); border-color: var(--primary-edge, #cc9f1f); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions: cancel, sign out, pagination.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-family: Mitr, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border, #2a2f45); background: var(--surface, #141726); color: var(--ink, #eef1fb); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 13px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.35); transition: transform .08s ease, box-shadow .08s ease, filter .08s ease, border-color .08s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-alt, #1c2036); border-color: var(--muted, #8b92ac); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(.97); box-shadow: none; filter: brightness(.94); }

components.name: Danger Outline Button
components.description: Delete actions only, in a two-click confirm sequence (label changes to "ยืนยัน?" on first click; confirming state fills solid with Crimson Tube).
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-family: Mitr, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border, #2a2f45); background: var(--surface, #141726); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 13px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.35); transition: transform .08s ease, box-shadow .08s ease, filter .08s ease; } .ds-btn-danger { color: var(--danger, #ff4d5e); border-color: var(--danger, #ff4d5e); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(255,77,94,.08); } .ds-btn-danger.confirming { background: var(--danger-fill, #ff4d5e); border-color: var(--danger-fill, #ff4d5e); color: var(--on-accent, #0b0d16); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(.97); box-shadow: none; filter: brightness(.94); }

components.name: Work Chip
components.description: Marks a task or event as "งาน" (Work). Colored text on a faintly tinted transparent ground, never a solid fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: Mitr, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-chip-work { color: var(--work, #2dd4f0); border: 1.5px solid var(--work, #2dd4f0); background: rgba(45,212,240,.08); }

components.name: Personal Chip
components.description: Marks a task or event as "ส่วนตัว" (Personal).
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: Mitr, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-chip-personal { color: var(--personal, #f43f8e); border: 1.5px solid var(--personal, #f43f8e); background: rgba(244,63,142,.08); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Task title, notes, and every other free-text field in the add-task form.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="ชื่องาน">
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: Mitr, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border, #2a2f45); background: var(--bg, #0b0d16); color: var(--text, #eef1fb); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary, #ffcc33); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sign Panel (signature card)
components.description: The shared material for every list row, task card, and panel: a dark, 10px-rounded panel with a neutral 1.5px frame and a small uncolored shadow. Plays the powerOff keyframe on delete or completion.
components.html: ส่งรายงานประจำเดือน
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; background: var(--surface, #141726); border: 1.5px solid var(--border, #2a2f45); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.4); padding: 9px 12px; } .ds-panel-title { font-family: Mitr, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text, #eef1fb); } .ds-panel.tearing { animation: dsPowerOff .4s ease-in forwards; pointer-events: none; } @keyframes dsPowerOff { 0% { opacity: 1; } 12% { opacity: .25; } 24% { opacity: 1; } 38% { opacity: .15; } 55% { opacity: .8; } 72% { opacity: .1; } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.97); } }

components.name: View Tab (Navigation)
components.description: One of three view toggles (List / Kanban / Calendar) living inside a bordered pill container; pairs a line icon with Thai text.
components.html: <button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="4" cy="6" r="1"/><line x1="8" y1="6" x2="20" y2="6"/><circle cx="4" cy="12" r="1"/><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="20" y2="12"/><circle cx="4" cy="18" r="1"/><line x1="8" y1="18" x2="20" y2="18"/></svg> รายการ</button>
components.css: .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: none; background: transparent; font-family: Mitr, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 6px 13px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink, #eef1fb); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--surface-alt, #1c2036); } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--primary, #ffcc33); color: var(--on-primary, #0b0d16); }

narrative.overview:
Life Dashboard's second full redesign replaced "The Shop Calendar" (a printing-house tear-off pad) with an entirely different material: a strip of shop-front neon tube signage seen at night. This is a solo daily-use tool, not a marketing surface, so the reference stays functional -- every task is a sign, lit or unlit, and finishing or deleting one plays a brief power-off flicker before it's gone.

The palette is a near-black night ground carrying two neon tube colors with one job each -- electric cyan for "งาน", hot magenta for "ส่วนตัว" -- plus an amber "OPEN sign" color for the one primary action and a green tube for done/success. An early build pass leaned on blurred colored glow to sell the neon read; the mechanical detector flagged every instance as the generic "AI-generated dark UI" cliche, and every glow was cut rather than merely dimmed. The shipped system carries its signage identity entirely through saturated color, 1.5px outline, and shape, with zero blur anywhere.
keyCharacteristics: A near-black night ground under dark panel cards -- no paper, no cream; committed to a single always-dark theme with no light-mode variant.
Two neon tube colors with one job each -- cyan for งาน, magenta for ส่วนตัว -- plus amber for the one primary action and green for done/success.

Zero blur-based glow anywhere -- identity is carried by saturated color, 1.5px outline, and shape alone, a deliberate correction after the detector caught the initial pass's colored halos as a known slop pattern.
Chips are colored text on a faintly tinted transparent ground, never a solid color fill with white text.
Moderate rounded corners (10px panels, fully pill-shaped chips) -- a bent neon tube, not a cut-paper edge.
One signature motion: a task's sign flickers and powers off the moment it's marked done or deleted.

rules.name: The One Job Per Color Rule
rules.body: Every neon color has exactly one meaning app-wide (cyan = work, magenta = personal, green = done/important, amber = the primary action, crimson = danger). The wordmark's magenta is the sole decorative exception.

rules.name: The 4.5:1 Floor
rules.body: Any color paired with text clears at least 4.5:1 against its actual background. --on-primary exists because white text fails against Amber Tube.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No text-shadow or colored box-shadow blur appears anywhere. An early pass used both and the detector flagged it as slop; every instance was cut, not thinned. Depth and identity come from saturated color, a 1.5px outline, and shape only.

rules.name: The Masthead-Only Rule
rules.body: Kanit appears only at Display or Heading scale (>=18px); it never appears on densely-repeated content.

dos: Do keep every panel's border 1.5px solid Frame Dim (or the matching semantic color) at 10px radius, with a small neutral shadow.
Do reserve Green Tube for completion/importance only.
Do keep Kanit at Display/Heading scale only (>=18px).
Do play the powerOff flicker on done/delete and nowhere else.
Do render chips as colored text on a faint tint, never a solid fill.
donts: Don't add a text-shadow or colored box-shadow blur anywhere -- it was tried, flagged as slop, and removed for good.
Don't put white text on Amber Tube -- use --on-primary.
Don't let Cyan, Magenta, Green, Crimson, or Amber mean anything other than their one assigned role.
Don't ship a light-mode variant -- this world is committed to always-dark.
Don't use an emoji or Unicode glyph as a stand-in icon.
